\section*{Per-text agreement and per-trial differences}
\label{sec:supp-text}

Generated from the result files of question 3. The values pooled over speeds are given for comparison only, because a difference in level between speeds inflates a pooled ICC. The mixtures weight the speeds (slow, mid, fast) as stated. The per-trial differences (observation minus reference) are given per scenario and speed with the mean on each side, so that the scenarios can be weighted differently; the views that leave out the trials of the carry layers need the layers of the prediction and are not computed for the Windows cell.
